title: The 'Safe Account' That Was the Scam
hook: A bank caller says your money is unsafe. Move it to a 'safe account.'
description: FBI IC3 Phantom Hacker advisory, 29 September 2023: tech-support impostors may hand victims to a fake financial-institution representative who orders funds moved to a supposed safe account. FBI account-takeover guidance: hang up and call the financial institution using a verified number. Sources: https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2023/PSA230929 and https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2025/PSA251125 . Recreated visuals are illustrations.

scenes.narration: A 'bank' caller says your money is unsafe. Move it to a 'safe account.'
scenes.heading: THE ORDER
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The FBI calls it the Phantom Hacker scam. It can begin with fake tech support.
scenes.heading: FIRST ACT
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The tech impostor may ask you to open financial accounts, revealing which balance is worth targeting.
scenes.heading: ACCOUNT CHECK
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: A second impostor claims to be from your bank and demands an immediate transfer.
scenes.heading: SECOND ACT
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The destination is described as a protected third-party account, sometimes falsely linked to a government agency.
scenes.heading: THE TRAP
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: The FBI says victims may be told to keep the real reason secret. That secrecy blocks independent checks.
scenes.heading: THE TURN
scenes.label: Illustration

scenes.narration: Hang up and call your bank using a number you found independently. If you transferred funds, contact your bank immediately and report the incident at IC3.gov.
scenes.heading: THE RULE
scenes.label: Illustration

notes: FBI IC3 29 September 2023 Phantom Hacker advisory documents the three personas, false virus scan, balance inspection, purported safe third-party account, and secrecy request.
FBI IC3 25 November 2025 account-takeover advisory supports hanging up, dialing a verified financial-institution number, and prompt bank/IC3 reporting.
Illustrated interface and caller are not represented as a real recording.
